qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary leisure and corporate travel is non-essential and deferrable in economic downturns; hotel lodging does not meet the essential Western need or high-frequency everyday habit standard.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). While IHG operates an asset-light franchise fee model, hotel lodging is fundamentally discretionary leisure and corporate travel that is deferrable during economic recessions, failing the essential Western need standard.
qualitative.evidence: IHG operates ~920k rooms across 19 brands with >70% of operating profit from franchise royalties. However, end-market demand is driven by cyclical travel, resulting in severe RevPAR collapses during downturns (-52% in 2020). Historical debt-funded share repurchases also led to negative book equity and elevated leverage (~5.5x Net Debt/NI).
